property_summary: c.owner() always returns the stored owner (address(0) for a freshly deployed, uninitialized C) and no non-owner caller can ever change it via transferOwnership; the mutant makes owner() return msg.sender, so any fuzzed caller becomes the 'owner', transferOwnership succeeds, and owner() stops being address(0).
change_summary: Return msg.sender instead of _owner, so owner() returns the caller rather than the stored owner.
